markets.name: The Farm Stand - Farmers Market
markets.street: 1702 East Old Colorado City Highway, Big Spring, TX, USA
markets.about: The Farm Stand - Farmers Market is a year-round storefront and outdoor farmers market in Big Spring, Texas. Shop local produce, meat, eggs, honey, baked goods, canned goods, and handmade finds from local makers. Our storefront is open Monday-Friday 10am-6pm and Saturday 9am-2pm,
